toc.title: Where each area lives in this course
How to read the exam wording

html:
1What the exam is

SC-900 (Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals) is a beginner-level exam. It is for business stakeholders, new or existing IT professionals and students who want to understand the fundamentals of security, compliance and identity across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365. You must describe what each Microsoft solution does and pick the right one for a short scenario. You do not need to configure anything.

Fact Value
Time 45 minutes
Passing score 700 or more, on a scale of 1 to 1,000
Retake 24 hours after the first attempt; later waits vary
Format Proctored; may include interactive components
Languages English first; other languages about eight weeks later
Number of questions, price [Verify live] not on the pages this course was built from: confirm on the exam page. The price depends on the country or region.
Note

. A score of 700 is not 70%. Do not compute a percentage; aim to understand every skill in the study guide.

2The four skill areas

Skill area Weight What it asks
Concepts of security, compliance and identity 10–15% Zero Trust, defense in depth, encryption, GRC, authentication and authorization
Capabilities of Microsoft Entra 25–30% Identity types, MFA, Conditional Access, roles, governance, protection
Capabilities of Microsoft security solutions 35–40% Azure network security, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Defender XDR
Capabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions 20–25% Service Trust Portal, Purview, labels, DLP, retention, insider risk, eDiscovery, audit

Security solutions is the biggest area. Most questions ask which product does what, so learn each product with its one-line purpose.

Exam tip

. Microsoft renamed many products. Questions may use old or new names: Azure Active Directory is Microsoft Entra ID; Microsoft 365 Defender is Microsoft Defender XDR; Azure AD Identity Protection is Microsoft Entra ID Protection; Microsoft Cloud App Security is Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.

3Where each area lives in this course

Modules Skill area
1, 2 Concepts of security, compliance and identity
3, 4, 5, 6 Microsoft Entra
7, 8, 9, 10 Microsoft security solutions
11, 12, 13, 14 Microsoft compliance solutions
15 All: exam technique and final review

4How to read the exam wording

Word What you must be able to do
Describe Explain what it is and what it is for
Define Give the meaning in one sentence
Identify the capability Pick the product or feature that fits a need

5A repeatable way to answer

  1. Read the last sentence first: what is asked?
  2. Find the key need: sign-in, access rules, threats on email, data labels, audit.
  3. Name the product family: Entra (identity), Defender (threats), Sentinel (SIEM), Purview (data and compliance).
  4. Remove products from other families.
  5. Choose the most specific match. Mark and move on if unsure after a minute.
Exam tip

. Four families answer most questions: Entra controls who gets in; Defender stops and detects threats; Sentinel collects and analyzes security events; Purview protects data and manages compliance.

6A study plan

Step What to do Modules
1 Concepts: security, compliance and identity 1–2
2 Microsoft Entra 3–6
3 Security solutions 7–10
4 Compliance solutions 11–14
5 Review with the cards and practice questions 15

Spaced review: answer each module's recall questions from memory, then check; repeat the Quick Reference Card the next day and after a week.

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors asks which skill area has the largest weight in SC-900. Which is it?

  • AConcepts of security, compliance and identity
  • BCapabilities of Microsoft Entra
  • CCapabilities of Microsoft security solutions
  • DCapabilities of Microsoft compliance solutions
Show the answer

Answer: C. Microsoft security solutions is 35–40%, the largest. Entra is 25–30%, compliance 20–25% and concepts 10–15%.

S2A candidate scores 700. What does this mean?

  • AThe candidate answered 70% of the questions correctly, so the exam is passed
  • BThe candidate reached the passing score on a scale of 1 to 1,000
  • CThe candidate failed and must wait a week
  • DThe candidate needs a higher exam level before the result counts
Show the answer

Answer: B. 700 or more on a scale of 1 to 1,000 passes. It is not a percentage.

S3A question uses the name "Azure Active Directory". Which product does it mean?

  • AMicrosoft Purview
  • BMicrosoft Sentinel
  • CMicrosoft Defender for Cloud
  • DMicrosoft Entra ID
Show the answer

Answer: D. Azure Active Directory was renamed Microsoft Entra ID.

S4A question asks which family protects data with labels and manages compliance. Which family is it?

  • AMicrosoft Entra
  • BMicrosoft Purview
  • CMicrosoft Defender XDR
  • DAzure Firewall
Show the answer

Answer: B. Purview covers data protection, governance and compliance.

7.2 Recall questions

R1How long is SC-900, and what score passes?

Show the answer

45 minutes; 700 on a scale of 1 to 1,000.

R2Name the four skill areas.

Show the answer

Concepts; Microsoft Entra; Microsoft security solutions; Microsoft compliance solutions.

R3Which area has the largest weight?

Show the answer

Microsoft security solutions (35–40%).

R4What was Azure Active Directory renamed?

Show the answer

Microsoft Entra ID.

R5Which part of a question do you read first?

Show the answer

The last sentence.

R6Which family manages data and compliance?

Show the answer

Microsoft Purview.

8Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format 45 minutes; pass at 700 of 1,000; proctored; retake after 24 hours
Areas concepts 10–15%, Entra 25–30%, security solutions 35–40%, compliance 20–25%
Families Entra = who; Defender = threats; Sentinel = events (SIEM); Purview = data and compliance
Old names Azure AD = Entra ID; Microsoft 365 Defender = Defender XDR; Cloud App Security = Defender for Cloud Apps
